prompt:
A 3-column by 2-row grid of 6 circular pirate achievement badge emblems, hand-painted game-art style, soft painterly shading and a beveled metal rim. Each badge is a round medallion coin centered in its own cell with generous transparent margin around it. Transparent background. No text, no numbers, no letters anywhere. No glow, no halos, no light rays, no glowing edges, no emissive or luminous effects on anything. Consistent lighting, consistent medallion size across all six. Each badge's metal tier: bronze = humble, silver = accomplished, gold = elite, ornate jeweled gold = legendary.

Read left-to-right, top row then bottom row:

Leviathan Hall (silver) — a tall cutaway bunkhouse of six stacked timber berths with a hanging lantern on each level, the deepest berth at the bottom panelled in dark sea-teal timber.
Fully Outfitted (silver) — a drill mallet crossed over a fat provisions barrel bound in brass hoops, coiled rope beneath, every rack stocked and ready.
Deep Cut (bronze) — a thick brass plate with a single deep teal gemstone set into it, the metal around the gem scored and carved far deeper than the rest.
Full Complement (gold) — a ring of ten small round brass rank-pips set on dark oiled wood, every one of them filled and polished, none empty.
Divine Hand (gold) — an upturned open palm rendered as a carved gold sigil cradling three large cut gemstones, one crimson, one teal, one gold.
Choir of the Deep (ornate jeweled gold) — six cut teal-white gemstones arranged in a ring around a dark still center, the rim heavily worked and jewelled, the grandest of the six.
